[[File:Abyssal lord icon.png|left]]
'''Abyssal lords''' are a type of [[demon]] players can find in the [[Senntisten Asylum]] and the [[Wilderness]]. They are the strongest of the [[Abyssal demons (type)|Abyssal demons]]. They require a [[Slayer]] level of 115 to be harmed. 

They are killed for their [[abyssal scourge]] drop, a tier 92 main-hand weapon with unique bleeding abilities. They are also killed for the [[Scions of Erebus]] book, a lore book that must be read as part of the [[master quest cape]] requirement, [[Message from the Abyss]]. They also drop the [[gate key]], which is required for the [[completionist cape]] requirement, [[Abyssal Shortcut]].

When killed on an [[Abyssal demons (Slayer assignment)|abyssal demons slayer assignment]] or [[Demons (Slayer assignment)|demons slayer assignment]], each kill reduces the count by 5. When killed on an [[Abyssal lords (Slayer assignment)|abyssal lords slayer assignment]], each kill reduces the count by 1.

==Mechanics==
Abyssal lords use a standard magic attack. They are also capable of teleporting like all other abyssal demons; unlike the teleports performed by their lessers, a lord's teleport will always hit and damage the player. They can periodically summon two [[abyssal tentacle]]s in a 5 × 5 area around the player's location. They attack with magic damage that ignores defensives such as [[Devotion]]. It is recommended to kill the tentacles with area-of-effect abilities or an [[Oldak coil]], as they can quickly stack up damage. The abyssal tentacles will also persist and continue to attack after the summoning abyssal lord has died so may stack up in number if they are not killed when fighting consecutive abyssal lords. [[Dominion mine]]s work particularly well against the lords due to their high health.

==Trivia==
* The [[abyssal savage]], [[abyssal beast]], and abyssal lord were designed by [[Mod Shogun]] during [[Game Jam]] 2017 and 2018.
* The abyssal lord is the only non-boss monster to drop tier 90+ weaponry.
